data.name: Annam
data.gender_notes: Annam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root word 'nun', which means 'grace' or 'favor'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the abundant blessings and mercy bestowed upon believers by Allah. The name Annam carries the meaning “Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Annam usually hope their child will grow to embody grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Annam is a reminder of the divine grace and compassion that surrounds us. It inspires us to be kind and compassionate towards others, and to remember that we are all connected in the web of life.
data.etymology: Annam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Annam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Annam was a sultan of the Malacca Sultanate in the late 15th century. He is known for his successful defense against Portuguese attempts to conquer Malacca.
historical_references.context: Malacca Sultanate, defense against Portuguese conquest

historical_references.reference: Annam was a ruler of the Cham people in present-day Vietnam in the 17th century. He was the founder of the Nguyen Dynasty and is considered the first emperor of Vietnam.
historical_references.context: Cham people, founder of Nguyen Dynasty and first emperor of Vietnam

The term 'Annam' itself comes from the Arabic language and is derived from the word 'ann' which means 'food'. In modern times, this term has gained popularity on various digital platforms such as Instagram, Pinterest, and YouTube. On Instagram, users often post pictures of delicious Islamic dishes with the hashtag #Annam, showcasing the vibrant colors, textures, and flavors of these dishes. On Pinterest, boards dedicated to Islamic food and recipes under the title 'Annam' are a hit among users, providing a visual and interactive platform for exploring and learning about different Islamic dishes. On YouTube, cooking channels and recipe videos labeled under 'Annam' offer step-by-step instructions and tips for preparing these dishes at home. Overall, the modern context of the term 'Annam' reflects a growing appreciation and celebration of Islamic food and culture, and its use on these platforms is a testament to the global reach and influence of these traditions.
